```{r}
# Visualizing dose response of the original and augmented data
std.err = function(x, na.rm = T) sd(x, na.rm = T)/sqrt(length(x))
aug_dab18_data %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc.),
                                                   names_to = 'pairs',
                                                   values_to = 'fluorescence') %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=Conc., y=fluorescence, color = target_vector))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap('pairs', scales = 'free')+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,5))+
  scale_x_log10()

aug_dab18_data %>% pivot_longer(cols = -c(target_vector, Conc.),
                                                   names_to = 'pairs',
                                                   values_to = 'fluorescence') %>% 
  group_by(Conc., target_vector, pairs) %>%
  summarise(average_fluorescence = mean(fluorescence),
            se = std.err(fluorescence)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Conc., y=average_fluorescence, color = target_vector))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=average_fluorescence-se, ymax = average_fluorescence+se), width = 0.2)+
  facet_wrap('pairs', scales = 'free')+
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,5))+
  scale_x_log10()
```

```{r}
# Random forest model - dAb18
augmented_random_forest_model = function(dataset,
                                         target,
                                         k_folds,
                                         model_type){
  pred_concs = NULL
  
  # Thresholding at 0.1 ng/ml corresponds to a threshold of 71.4 pM
  dataset = dataset %>% filter(Conc. > 0.4)
  folds = createFolds(dataset[[target]], k = k_folds)
  train_control = trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                               number = 5,
                               repeats = 3)
  model_formula = paste(target, '~', ".", "-Conc.") %>% as.formula()
  
  for (fold in 1:k_folds){
    train = dataset[-folds[[fold]],]
    test = dataset[folds[[fold]],]
    
    test_conc = test$Conc.
    
    preprocess = preProcess(train, method = c("center", "scale"))
    train = predict(preprocess, train)
    test = predict(preprocess, test)
    
    x_test = test %>% select(-target)
    y_test = test[[target]]
    
    if (model_type == 'rf'){
      trained_model = train(model_formula,
                            data = train,
                            method = 'ranger',
                            importance = 'impurity',
                            trControl = train_control)

      predictions = predict(trained_model, x_test,
                            type = 'raw')
    }
    
    if (model_type == 'svm'){
      trained_model = train(model_formula,
                            data = train,
                            method = 'linearSVM',
                            trControl = train_control)
      predictions = predict(trained_model, x_test,
                            type = 'raw')
    }
    
  # print(varImp(trained_model))
  accuracy = Accuracy(predictions, test[[target]])
  print(accuracy)
  
  pred_df = data.frame("concentration" = test_conc,
                       "predictions" = predictions,
                       "labels" = y_test)
  
  if (is.null(pred_concs)){
    pred_concs = pred_df
  }
  else {
    pred_concs = pred_concs %>% bind_rows(pred_concs, pred_df)
  }
  # print(trained_model)
  }
  pred_concs = pred_concs %>% arrange(desc(concentration))
  return(pred_concs)
}


all_data = augmented_random_forest_model(dataset = augmented_dab18_data,
                              target = "target_vector",
                              k_folds = 5,
                              model_type = "rf")

aug_only = augmented_random_forest_model(dataset = aug_dab18_data,
                              target = "target_vector",
                              k_folds = 5,
                              model_type = "rf")

original_only = augmented_random_forest_model(dataset = og_dab18_data,
                              target = "target_vector",
                              k_folds = 5,
                              model_type = "rf")

denoise_augment18 = augmented_random_forest_model(dataset = denoise_augment18_data,
                                                  target = "target_vector",
                                                  k_folds = 5,
                                                  model_type = "rf")

# Percent correct by concentration for all data
percent_correct_visualization = function(dataset, color){
  viz = dataset %>% mutate(across(concentration, round, 4)) %>%
    mutate_at('concentration', as.factor) %>%  mutate(match = case_when(predictions == labels ~ 1,
                                                                        .default = 0)) %>% group_by(concentration) %>%
    summarize(num_correct = sum(match),
              total = n()) %>%
    mutate(percent_correct = (round(num_correct / total, 4)) * 100) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = concentration, y = percent_correct)) +
    geom_bar(stat = 'identity',
             fill = color) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent_correct),
              vjust  = 1.5,
              color = 'white') +
    theme_classic() +
    ylab('Percent Correct') +
    xlab('Concentration') +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.001))
  
  return(viz)
}

all_data_perc_correct = percent_correct_visualization(all_data, '#1D6363')

og_data_only_perc_correct = percent_correct_visualization(original_only, '#1D6363')

aug_only_perc_correct = percent_correct_visualization(aug_only, '#1D6363')

denoise_augment18_perc_correct = percent_correct_visualization(denoise_augment18, '#1D6363')
```
